instruction: Open or import the initial file(s) from the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\two_sided_housing.step. Create two independent Coordinate Systems or setups for C:\Users\User\Desktop\two_sided_housing.step. Side A machines the pocket and four holes; side B machines the two counterbores. The two setup Z axes must point in opposite directions. Tool definitions: T1 is a 12 mm end mill, T2 is a 6 mm end mill, and T3 is a 5 mm drill/counterbore tool as needed. Use the SolidCAM CAM-Part, Coordinate System, Stock, Tool Table, operation, simulation/verify, and post-processing dialogs as needed, then save the required output file(s) to the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-20_sideA.nc, C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-20_sideB.nc.
